prose.where: benzecri1960_ch1.tex:274–276 (GL, GA, generation of GA) and :294–302 (GS, GP, GL = ℝ⁺ × GU, i), journal p. 236; unlabelled
proved: GA(n, ℝ) is generated by GL(n, ℝ) and the translations: Benzecri.closure_linear_union_translations (via Benzecri.GAR.eq_translation_mul_linear)
GS(n−1, ℝ) = GL(n, ℝ)/ℝ⁺ acts on S(n−1): Benzecri.GSE E, MulAction (GSE E) (Sphere E), Benzecri.GSE.mk_smul; by homeomorphisms in finite dimension (ContinuousConstSMul instance)
the action of GS on S is faithful and rigid: instance IsAnalyticAction (GSE E) (Sphere E), Benzecri.GSE.eq_one_of_eqOn, Benzecri.mem_posHomotheties_of_eqOn (any real TVS E with {0} closed)
GL(n, ℝ) is the direct product of the positive homotheties (≅ ℝ⁺) and GU(n, ℝ): Benzecri.glEquivProd : (E ≃ₗ[ℝ] E) ≃* Units.posSubgroup ℝ × GU E, Benzecri.posHomothetiesEquiv

the isomorphism i : GS(n−1, ℝ) ≃* GU(n, ℝ): Benzecri.isoGU, Benzecri.isoGU_mk (i(ḡ) = |det g|^{-1/n} g), Benzecri.isoGU_symm_apply (i⁻¹ = projection restricted to GU), Benzecri.isoGU_smul; at the paper's indices Benzecri.isoGUR m : GSR m ≃* GUR (m+1)
GA(n, ℝ) is exactly the group of bijections of ℝⁿ affine in the sense of Déf. 2 (IsAffine ℝ, the linear reading of DEC-114): Benzecri.GAR.isAffine, Benzecri.GAR.exists_eq_of_isAffine
not_proved: « c'est le groupe des automorphismes de la structure projective de S(n−1) » — needs the projective structure (wave 2, Structure/Basic)
GP(n−1, ℝ) and its action on P(n−1) — not formalized (named only, unused in Ch. 1)

questions: p. 236 « GL(n, ℝ) est le produit direct … » needs n ≥ 1: for n = 0, GL(0) is trivial and the positive homotheties are not ≅ ℝ⁺. Formalized for E ≠ 0 ([Nontrivial E]); at the paper's indices GS(m) = GL(m+1)/ℝ⁺ so the case never arises. A reading, not a finding (S(n−1) with n = 0 is empty).
kb_proposals: Rigidity of GS on S(E) is Benzecri.exists_forall_eq_smul_of_isOpen: a linear map with every vector of a nonempty open set an eigenvector is a homothety (proved by two points of the line x + t•y and LinearIndependent.eq_of_pair). The GS action instance is MulAction.compHom through QuotientGroup.lift of MulAction.toPermHom; g • x for g = mk g' reduces by rfl (GSE.mk_smul).

Paper index: GSR m = GS(m, ℝ) = GL(m+1)/ℝ⁺ acts on S m = Sphere (Fin (m+1) → ℝ): IsAnalyticAction (GSR m) (S m) and ContinuousConstSMul (GSR m) (S m) are instances, ready for gxGroupoid (GSR n) (S n).
